name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.86: enforces the fridge basket numbering contract at the basket PUT. basket is 1-16 within each cabinet and cabinet (A/B) disambiguates (the storage PK is deviceCode,cabinet,basket), so a basket outside 1-16 or a cabinet the model lacks is now rejected with bad_basket / bad_cabinet rather than stored. The four fridge command types (fridge_open_door, scale_read, scale_calibrate, scale_tare) were already in the command allow-list since v5.78. Cumulative over v5.85.
